fields.evidence: operands op0..; Ghidra param_1[n] = op[n-1] (chunk 12 convention); chunk 10 names them a,b,c,d (+4,+8,+0xc,+0x10); chunk 11 a1..a5 (+4..+0x14)

fields.name: op[k] (scopeSlot)
fields.evidence: for kinds 0x25,0x26,0x27,0x28,0x2d,0x3d,0x3e,0x44 the last operand(s) are placeholders (g_083deec0[4]==g_lex_reserved==0 passed at reduce time) that Scr_CreateFunctionContext/ScrScope_Analyze*/Scr_BuildSwitchTable overwrite with a ScrLocalBlock* (e.g. &p[3] for if, &p[5],&p[6] for if/else, &p[4] while, &p[6],&p[7] for, &p[2] dev block, &p[5] function)

conflicts: Three chunk-local structs with fixed sizes 0x14 / 0x18 / 0x24; none matches the allocation. Real allocation is 4*N where N is the Make arity of the producing rule (e.g. kind 0x07 literals Make3 = 12 bytes, kind 0x28 for-loop Make9 = 36 bytes). Fixed-size views are safe only for in-range operands. Chunk 11's enum SCR_NODE_FILE_FUNC_REF=0x1e is wrong (0x1e = thread call target).

name: ScrList

fields.name: head
fields.evidence: ScrList_Create (0x08078da0) stores head at +0; ScrList_PushFront writes list->head; chunk 12 seq->list at +4 of the head NODE

fields.name: tail
fields.evidence: ScrList_Append (0x08078e3c) uses list->tail->next; ScrList_Splice (0x08078e94)

defined_in: chunk_012_types.h (cod2_scr_seq models the dummy head NODE, not the list)
conflicts: Chunks 10/11 declare only head (valid for headless 4-byte lists built with ScrBox_Make1(0)+ScrList_PushFront, rules 111/112). Statement/param/waittill lists are 8-byte {head,tail} lists whose first node is a dummy (value = pointer to a zeroed 1-word box) so real items start at head->next; chunk 12 calls that dummy node 'cod2_scr_seq {unused0,list}' and accesses seq->list == head->next. Two list shapes coexist: dummy-headed {head,tail} (stmt/param/include/toplevel/waittill) and headless {head} (expression/argument lists).
